scope: scripts/probe_safety_logic.py on a frozen Debug build of a7740570 (artifacts/w2bs5, git archive), 25/25 steps, PLCSIM Advanced V8 on Softbus. Owned scratch with the standard CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and an added CPU 1511F-1 PN 6ES7 511-1FL03-0AB0/V4.1 (configureScratchSecurity, failsafeRuntimeAccess; owned scratch only) plus an ET 200SP station with two F-DI 8x24VDC HF (input start byte 0). project_simulation_enable without plcPath compiled all three devices with zero errors; safety_inspect showed no safety password and no login. safety_import_xml re-imported Main_Safety_RTG1 changed to two F-FBD networks (SafeOut %M100.0 := F-DI channel 0 by absolute address %I0.0, SafeAlive %M100.1 := TRUE) with checkpoint, device compile including the safety program (zero errors) and save; the F-runtime group kept FOB_RTG1/Main_Safety_RTG1. sim_create created an owned PLCSIM instance of ECPUType CPU1511F (license OK). simulation_download compiled the F-PLC (safety program consistent, zero errors), presented no download configuration callback, and then V21's offline DownloadProvider refused: EngineeringTargetInvocationException 'Error when calling method Download of type Siemens.Engineering.Download.DownloadProvider. An error has occured during download: Load safety program to device'. No memory card was written; the owned instance was released (unregistered). This is the boundary of the offline memory-card route for an F-CPU: the changed F-logic compiles but cannot be loaded into PLCSIM this way, so F-logic behavior and F-I/O injection were not reached.
limitations: Only the offline DownloadProvider memory-card route (simulation_download) was tried; the online PLCSIM download route (simulation_download_online) is untested for an F-CPU.
No safety acceptance, login or password; the scratch user's fail-safe access exists in the owned scratch only.
